name: brief-video-editor
description: Dùng khi da co y tuong va can huong dan NGUOI QUAY hoac NGUOI DUNG PHIM — storyboard tung beat, footage phai quay, chu chay tren man hinh, nhac, nhip cat, end-frame CTA va spec xuat theo kenh. Khac script video: script la loi thoai, day la huong dan dung. Kích hoạt khi người dùng nhắc 'brief video', 'brief editor', 'storyboard', 'brief dung phim', 'huong dan cat video', 'brief videographer', 'editor cat khong dung y', 'video dai qua can cat lai'. Không dùng cho — viet loi thoai va hook noi truoc camera thi dung skill script-video; nho khach hoac nhan vien tu quay thi dung skill brief-ugc-egc; thue production house tron goi thi dung skill agency-vendor-brief.
